result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I didn't add tests for the new cases, and the run of `*Convention*` tests printed no output. I didn't check whether any test class matched that name, so I never saw a test exercise these patterns.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`, with `html` listed twice. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered and `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **Generated code:** the `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule and the `<doc>` .NET documentation rule used `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml`, which only match a file literally named `.js` or `.xml`. They are now `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`.
- **Gradle script:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` required a literal `.-gradle.js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, which matches `build-gradle.js`. The separate `.*[.]gradle` rule is unchanged, so `build.gradle` still matches.

Ordinary `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files still stay out of these scopes, because the content patterns (generator comment, `<doc>` line) still have to match.
